overview: The Legion Garrison is the heart of Sanctus Seru’s military might, housing the disciplined soldiers who enforce imperial doctrine.
history: Constructed during the rise of Seru’s authoritarian rule.
Expanded repeatedly to support massed legion deployments.
Arcane stabilizers were added to reinforce drill yards and command towers.
The garrison became the staging ground for enforcement campaigns across Luclin.
hooks: A legion cohort reports sabotage in the drill yard.
A command tower’s stabilizer pulses irregularly.
A sealed edict orders immediate mobilization.
A recruit disappears during formation trials.
